intent: Brokerage-grade price chart: precise, calm at rest, rich under the cursor. Hand-drawn SVG, responsive, keyboard accessible.

stack.animation: motion/react: motion values for the entrance, range morph and counting figures (no per-frame React state); layoutId for the range pill

layout.card: bg #0b0b0c (light: #ffffff), border ink/8%, radius 22px, inset top highlight + deep shadow, padding 20/28px, @container root. No glow.
layout.header: identity + price + delta left; range segmented control right (full width on mobile)
layout.plot: ResizeObserver width; height 320px (230px < 520px); 56px right gutter for y labels (none on mobile); 40px volume band; 22px x-axis band
layout.footer: 4-col stat grid (2-col mobile) with 1px gaps: Open, High, Low, Volume

color.approach: monochrome card; green and red are the data (up/down) and appear only on the line, its area, the change and the dots
color.tokens: one PALETTE object per theme, written to --cp-* CSS variables

motion.entrance: Once at 35% in view; server HTML starts hidden. Card lands (opacity + 16px rise, no blur, 0.6s). Then, in seconds: identity row 0.06, price 0.12, change 0.18, range control 0.14 (each a 12px rise out of an 8px blur); gridlines and axis labels 0.20; the line rises from the plot floor in a left-to-right wave from 0.24 over 1.0s (progress clamp(t*1.6 − i/n*0.6), ease-out cubic; invisible until it starts), volume bars grow with it and the area fades in; the four stats rise from 0.42 at 60ms steps. Every figure counts up from 0 over 0.9s while an 8px blur clears. The live dot springs in as the wave lands, then pings (the one ambient signal).
motion.implementation: intro and morph are motion values; line, area and volume are derived path strings (useTransform) bound to motion.path d, so nothing re-renders per frame; figures are motion values rendered as text
motion.rangeMorph: resample all series to 140 points; morph values and the price domain together over 650ms ease-out quart, starting from wherever the previous morph was
motion.figures: scrubbing is instant; range changes and pointer-leave count to new values over 450ms
motion.tooltip: date pill rises 4px and fades in over 160ms
motion.reducedMotion: short fades only; line, figures and stats are final immediately; no ping

responsive.mobile: range control full width; plot 72% height; no y gutter; 3 x labels; stats 2-up
responsive.desktop: y labels in gutter; 5 x labels; stats 4-up

accessibility: plot is focusable with role=img and a summary aria-label
ArrowLeft/Right inspect points, Shift for 10, Escape clears

content.name: Northwind Growth Index
content.data: { t: epoch ms, v: price, vol: volume }[] per range; demo data is a seeded random walk

avoid: a trend-tinted glow behind the card
